title: Oscar and the Sigil
author: Dominic Winterbourne
blurb: Hazel Voss, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
